dish: Modern-französisches Signature-Menü mit Wissler-Klassikern (Gänseleber, Reh) — 2 Michelin-Sterne
w: The corridor's gastronomic summit, in the Althoff Grandhotel Schloss Bensberg: Joachim Wissler held three Michelin stars here for 17 years (two since 2022) before handing the kitchen to sous-chef Dennis Kuckuck in October 2025. Classic French base, modern signatures, and a strong vegetarian menu.

dish: Saisonales Gourmet-Menü (1 Michelin-Stern) in der Diepeschrather Mühle
w: TV chef Nelson Müller moved his Essen restaurant into the new Diepeschrather Mühle in a forest clearing in January 2025; after a year without a star it regained a Michelin star in the 2026 guide. Sustainable, ambitious cooking at a 30-seat chef's-table room with an open kitchen.

Ghanaian-born, Wiesbaden-raised chef Anthony Sarpong has held a Michelin star in Meerbusch since 2015, blending West African flavours with modern European technique. One of the few starred kitchens between Cologne and Düsseldorf.

dish: Klassisch-französische Küche mit mediterranem Akzent auf der Rheinterrasse (Michelin-empfohlen)
w: A refined, long-established Rhine-side restaurant and beer garden in Meerbusch, recommended in the Michelin Guide, where chef Guy de Vries plates classic French technique brightened with Mediterranean lift right beside the river.

dish: Wiener Schnitzel & saisonale rheinisch-französische Küche im Stadthaus
w: A Michelin-listed classic in a stately Neuss townhouse with a heritage staircase and a green courtyard garden — seasonal German-French cooking with a much-loved Wiener Schnitzel, the town's dependable address for a proper dinner.

dish: Cucina Creativa — hausgemachte Pasta & Trüffel im Grandhotel Schloss Bensberg
w: The relaxed Italian table of Schloss Bensberg, with its own wine boutique and a vine-draped terrace: homemade pasta, coastal fish and hearty country dishes with well-matched Italian wines — fine dining's easygoing sibling to the Vendôme.

dish: Dom's Alt — obergäriges Neusser Altbier — mit rustikaler Brauhausküche
w: Neuss's oldest inn and only surviving house brewery, brewing on this spot documented since 1607. Beside Bolten it is one of the world's oldest Altbier breweries — pour a Dom's Alt with hearty seasonal Rhenish plates in a medieval building by the Münster.

dish: Bergische Kaffeetafel & frische Bergische Waffeln mit heißen Kirschen und Sahne
w: A cosy half-timbered house in Herrenstrunden serving the full Bergische Kaffeetafel — 'Koffedrenken met allem Dröm un Draan', coffee from the Dröppelmina pot with sweet-and-savoury spreads, rice pudding and hot-cherry waffles — the Bergisches Land's great hospitality ritual.

dish: Bergische Kaffeetafel mit Dröppelmina-Kaffee, Bergischen Waffeln & Schlussschnaps
w: For nearly 150 years an inn among the meadows at the source of the Strunde, famous for its Bergische Kaffeetafel and Sunday Bergische Waffeln — coffee, cocoa and a closing schnapps included, served over a long, unhurried afternoon.

A defining family winery of the Siebengebirge, working ten hectares on the Drachenfels — a volcanic trachyte soil found in no other German wine region. Taste the Drachenfels Rieslings and reds in the Königswinter vinothek, the corridor's own wine.

A winegrowing family in Oberdollendorf since 1696, working the Laurentiusberg, Rosenhügel and Sülzenberg slopes at the foot of the Siebengebirge. Riesling, Spätburgunder and more, poured in a tasting room right below the vineyards.

dish: Hausgebrautes Siegburger Bier mit deftiger Brauhausküche
w: Siegburg's own brewpub off the market square, pouring house-brewed Siegburger beer with rustic Rhenish brauhaus fare and changing lunch dishes in a beery, timber-warm room below the Michaelsberg.

dish: Hausgemachter Kuchen & Frühstück auf der Sonnenterrasse am Markt
w: A café in Siegburg's city museum on the market square, with a big sun terrace and a generous afternoon spread of homemade cake — an easy pause between the Markt and the Michaelsberg climb.

dish: Gutbürgerlich-rheinische Küche mit Rheinterrasse in Niederdollendorf
w: A family Weinhaus directly on the Rhine at Königswinter-Niederdollendorf, pairing traditional Rhenish cooking and seasonal specialties with regional and Italian wines and a green riverside terrace in summer.
A market-square restaurant in Bad Honnef serving local Rhenish and hearty German cooking — a reliable, characterful table in the little spa town at the foot of the Siebengebirge.

dish: Himmel un Äd mit Flönz & Halve Hahn, Kölsch im Schlosspark-Biergarten
w: In Brühl's restored 1844 station beside the UNESCO palace park, a Rhenish wirtshaus for the classics — Himmel un Äd with Flönz, Halve Hahn, Flammkuchen and grills — with a Kölsch in the castle-park beer garden and a view to Augustusburg.
